description: My happiness is important and you will not take it away from me. #selflove #responsibility
transcript: And everything that I do, I chase my happiness. So if you are presenting unhappiness, if you are presenting misery, if you are presenting uncertainty to me, those are red flags and I remove myself from that person, place or thing, my happiness means everything to me. This time is so short and so limited and I will never get it back and I will not allow your misery to take it away from me.
